findings.obs_text: In Jam 2:4 making distinctions among themselves is what shows them judges with evil thoughts: the favoring is the outward form of the thoughts.
findings.grounds: have you not then made distinctions among yourselves

findings.obs_text: In Judg 13:3 barren is the woman's state before she is told she will conceive, in the bodily sense. In Luk 6:8 Jesus knows their thoughts and calls the man with the withered hand to stand: the withered hand is the occasion their thoughts watch.
In Job 20:2 Zophar's disquieting thoughts answer him because of the haste within him: the inner agitation drives the thoughts.
findings.grounds: because of my haste within me

findings.obs_text: In Judg 13:3, Judg 13:5, Judg 13:7, Isa 7:14, Mat 1:23 and Luk 1:31 bear follows conceive in the bodily sense. In 2Ch 13:8 Abijah tells Jeroboam he thinks to withstand the Lord's kingdom: the thought is to resist. In Jer 40:5 and 1Cor 7:26 remain is what is judged good, and in 1Cor 4:9 Paul thinks the apostles are set last.
findings.grounds: you think to withstand the kingdom of the Lord

findings.obs_text: In Gen 32:8 Jacob thinks that if Esau attacks one camp the other will escape: the thought plans an escape. In Est 4:13 Esther is not to think she will escape in the palace: the thought of escape is forbidden.
findings.grounds: the camp that is left will escape
